This is the best comment in this entire thread. Kudos to you.

2 Main reasons, one emotional and one economic.

Emotional: Humans associate mice and rats with disease so even if safe for the cat to eat the owners would likely not buy it for their pet.

Economic: We already have a vast food supply chain made of pork, chicken, beef, various fish, etc...before we even get into grains for fillers so there's no need to setup a new chain when there are already so many ingredients you can use. Using the current chain allows you to use cheap "trash" ingredients. In the US at least we have Human Grade and Animal Grade (trash) meats (There's more than 2 grades but keeping it simple). Animal grade meats include the use of sick/dying animals. These get sold even cheaper then normal animal grade meats so that gives options of either selling cheap to be a discount food at the market or sell at "normal" price and having a higher profit margin.
